content.title: ACCF/AHA STEMI Guidelines
content.focus: Improving outcomes for patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) through timely reperfusion therapy and related strategies.

strategies.description: Optimize timeliness of reperfusion therapy for STEMI.
strategies.source: Ting HH, Rihal CS, Gersh BJ, et al.

strategies.effectiveness: Associated with reduced time delay and mortality in patients with STEMI when delivered by ambulance-staffed paramedics.

strategies.benefit: Early identification and treatment of acute coronary syndrome in STEMI patients.

additional data.source: Bonnefoy E, Steg PG, et al.
additional data.comparison: In-hospital transfer for coronary intervention showed better outcomes.

additional data.research: Reduction of delay in door-to-balloon time
additional data.scientific focus: How to improve outcomes using door-to-balloon times within hospital systems.
additional data.notable efforts: Bradley EH, Curry LA, Webster TR, et al.
